interpretation.correctness: All hosted OD, facing, shoulder, taper, through-bore, blind-bore, repeated/retrace and bounded analogue cases produced valid one-body B-reps. Repeated 3D, batched 3D and axisymmetric reconstruction agreed in volume/bounds within the declared campaign budgets.
interpretation.analytic_geometry: Axisymmetric reconstruction retained planes/cylinders and a true cone for the taper case and introduced no B-spline surfaces in the measured set.
interpretation.step: All 21 enabled strategy/file combinations passed the automated AP242DIS millimetre manifold-solid write/read-back gates; this is not a substitute for independent downstream qualification in RCS-005.
interpretation.operation_scaling: The exact-retrace case preserved 100 journal events while the 2D material state required zero 3D material Booleans; 99 events were proven material no-ops. Aggregate timing strongly favored the specialized reconstruction on this small hosted set but is not a production performance claim.
interpretation.topology: Topology counts were generally equal across strategies; the blind-bore reconstruction used one additional face despite equivalent valid material. Therefore face-count identity is not a requirement and RCS-008 semantic lineage remains the durable identity model.
interpretation.scope_limit: The comparison starts from an oracle-derived completed axisymmetric removal envelope. Real insert/nose-radius/orientation envelope generation, parting/grooving connectivity and non-axisymmetric/live-tool operations remain outside the accepted provider subset until separately qualified.
